description: This file defines the NavigationMenuLinkTreeManipulators class, which provides methods to manipulate navigation menu link trees in Drupal, specifically adding 'overview' links to second-level menu items.

classes.name: NavigationMenuLinkTreeManipulators
classes.description: A class that manipulates navigation menu link trees by adding 'overview' links to second-level menu items.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes route provider, overrides, and translation services.

methods.name: addSecondLevelOverviewLinks
methods.description: Adds 'overview' child links to second-level menu items with children.

methods.name: shouldAddOverviewLink
methods.description: Determines if an 'overview' link should be added to a menu tree element.

methods.name: isEnabledAndAccessible
methods.description: Checks if a menu link tree element is enabled and accessible.

methods.name: addOverviewLink
methods.description: Adds an 'overview' menu link as a child to a menu tree element.
